answer:
Put the compiled `yourthing.plug.js` next to the library page, e.g. `Library/yourname/yourthing.plug.js`. Then list it under `files:` in the page's frontmatter so the library ships it on install.

Share: Page doesn't upload it. It only publishes the library page, so you have to commit the `.plug.js` and any other `files` assets to the repo yourself.
